examples.en: One voter in Brasilia summed up the mood – "Politicians have lost credibility," he complained.
examples.zh: 一位巴西利亚选民简述了人们的心情–“政治家们已丧失信誉，”他抱怨道。

examples.en: Credibility holds the key to development.
Two paradoxes exist throughout this credibility process.
examples.zh: 整个可信度论证过程中贯穿了两个悖论。
